rationale: The rule-specific contract requires interest_rate to be the all-in PIK-inclusive coupon. Raw SOI rows show separate cash and PIK legs: Panzura is 4.00% cash plus 15.00% PIK, while Island Bidco row 33 is 3.65% cash plus 7.25% PIK. The flagged residuals match cases where the stored interest_rate kept only the cash leg rather than cash plus PIK, so the stored rate is not all-in.
